# Eon Platform

> AI customer service on WhatsApp for small businesses in Latin America, built in Puerto Santa Cruz (Argentine Patagonia) by a solo, bootstrapped founder, JuanKLimoN, co-creating with Claude Code. Claude is the bots' primary model (with vision for payment receipts); a parallel NVIDIA model race and a 15-second safe reply back it up.

All figures on the site come from the projects' own engineering logs or git history. Unverified items are labelled as such.

## Docs

- [Technical dossier](eon.md): products, how Claude is used, measured engineering cases, ecosystem, languages, roadmap.
- [Website](index.html): the same content for people, in English and Spanish.

## Highlights

- DS4Windows 3.9.9 memory-corruption fix (GC-movable buffer under overlapped I/O): crashes 7/16 → 0/12, Fisher p ≈ 0.01.
- In-process Bluetooth audio to the PS4 controller with a hand-written SBC codec; adaptive rate limiting cut slow writes from 33 % to 4–9 %.
- Shared Claude-first AI module with no SDK, used by four WhatsApp bots; designed so the customer always gets an answer.
- Cross-device ecosystem across Windows, Android and Linux/Termux; PCs discovered over UDP by a Gradle-free Android app.
